rules: Each station's videos are read only from its own branch, and only numbers inside its ids ranges.
only_ids: the videos this entry may deliver; null = every video found on the station branches. Add numbers here (or set null) to let new videos in.

manifests: per video directory <video_root>/009-NNN/, the first existing manifest wins (latest internal round first). Its ZIP is joined from the byte parts listed in it and verified; the existing MP4, cover.jpg, weibo.txt and subtitle.srt inside it are re-stored unchanged as 009-NNN-DELIVERY.zip.
Only the repository owner edits this file (it lives on the protected default branch of opc-video-deliveries).
